title: Bound fixed-output complex child consolidation (0% κ change)
body:
## Result

**NO VERIFIED GAIN. The κ change is exactly 0%.** On the exact [#7161 native](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7161), every one of 6,279 old paid MOVE outputs is required in the tested fixed-output consolidation model. All 2,229 signed quotient classes and 978 target monomial cosets have full rational row rank. The widest target coset has 1,050 independent rows. Every contact-free serial chain has length one. The combined upper saving is zero across all 17 signed stages, even with free clocks, monomial adapters, retyping, restoration and added ordinary work. At κ = 0.0040075385047236 the old invoice retains a raw deficit of 140.51726295091429.

The output span argument assumes each coset is serviced by its retained complete outputs. It leaves typed multi-output children across cosets, other free source channels, changed contacts and across-read fusion open. This is exact #7161 scope. [#7244](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7244) is a different literal word and needs a separate census.

## Scope and overlap

Canonical `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`, changed `p104-side-correction` scope. Pins exact #7161 scientific head `e3f8d39c43b07063dfc5b800f71c5d21015259e6`, [#7113](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7113) signed caller `07a76c5e2738882c0cb322278e56f6cae3c9885d` and the two canonical Clifford implementations. [#7243](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7243) bounds cross-chart split capacity via existing paid transport. [#7171](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7171) tests serial fusion across live reads. This package exhausts the whole-output reuse and contact-free subfamilies. The separate CI navigation commit reuses the verified #7161 prerequisite.

## Replay

From a clean checkout with CPython 3.12 and assertions:

    python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-fixed-output-consolidation

Clean CPython 3.12.14 replay passed. It regenerates and authenticates the full row receipt without storing a second copy, reconstructs 110,519 paid positions and 22,427 productive targets, and checks the independent signed-tableau, clock and prime-field rank audit. All 22 committed-byte, mode and source-history checks and six navigation tests passed. The cap-one control retains every pending MOVE at ideal value. A changed caller and duplicate manifest path are rejected. No new native, compiler, tape or all-size multiplier replay ran. Hosted status is pending.

## Credit and next question

Credit Clear1nsight #7161, Rohan Arun #7113, #7165/#7171 for the native and serial interfaces, the canonical Clifford implementers, and Round 13 of [#7111](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/7111) for directed arithmetic. OpenAI Codex and subagents materially assisted. Apache-2.0.

A changed paid child must service multiple distinct output cosets under a complete arbitrary-input contract. Price its eligible whole stock and charge all new work before testing one local instance.
